selector.rationale: Both Lipoma and Ectopic lymph node have similar scores and supporting evidence, but Lipoma is a more common cause of a solitary, mobile, submucosal mass with a smooth mucosal surface.

rejected.label: Ectopic lymph node
rejected.why: Less common presentation as a solitary, mobile, submucosal mass
